mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, paper_id, research_question, methods, innovations, experiment_results, limitations_questions, personal_thoughts, version, create_time, update_time, is_delete FROM reading_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND paper_id = #{paperId} AND is_delete = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_note SET research_question = COALESCE(#{note.researchQuestion}, research_question), methods = COALESCE(#{note.methods}, methods), innovations = COALESCE(#{note.innovations}, innovations), experiment_results = COALESCE(#{note.experimentResults}, experiment_results), limitations_questions = COALESCE(#{note.limitationsQuestions}, limitations_questions), personal_thoughts = COALESCE(#{note.personalThoughts}, personal_thoughts), version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND paper_id = #{note.paperId} AND version = #{note.version} AND is_delete = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper WHERE id = #{note.paperId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_delete = 0)
